blurb: The built-in apps: timers and alarms, calendar, tasks, pantry and meals, fitness, trivia.
title: The built-in apps
_note: This is the SHIPPED vocabulary and the fail-open net. At runtime the keywords and examples below are replaced by the ones assembled from the manifests in apps/, so the router's app words are the apps the build actually has. With the five shipped apps installed the assembly reproduces this file exactly; a test holds the two together.
examples: set a timer for ten minutes
remind me to call the vet at four
what is on my calendar tomorrow
